jobs.title: Seasonal Operations Associate (Part-Time) - Old Town Alexandria
jobs.description_text: OBJECTIVE The Seasonal Operations Associate supports store goals during peak and high-volume business periods by delivering exceptional guest experiences and bringing the ALO Brand Mission to life. Through authentic connection, product expertise, and personalized service, this role drives operational excellence, builds customer loyalty, and contributes to a high-performing team environment. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Execute inventory management processes effectively with a focus om maximizing inventory accuracy & reducing shrink Investigate and root cause inventory accuracy issues, partnering with the General/Store Manager to escalate process or system gaps Support execution of key operational functions including shipment, receiving and processing, reverse transfers, sales floor recovery, intra-day sales floor replenishment, floor set updates, and supply management Maintain and champion strong visual standards for the sales floor Work closely with reporting, budgets, expenses, inventory control, supplies, vendor relationships, technology, and facilities to ensure maintained and maximized Support a safe work environment and efficient operation through strong stockroom standards and processes Move dynamically on the retail floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team and guests Execute company-level operations-focused directives, projects and initiates, in partnership with the Operations & Visual Management team. Assists in processing shipment and ensuring product flo

Consistent with Alo’s “Together We Win” principle, the Senior Analyst works collaboratively across functions, shares insights, builds alignment, and helps stakeholders turn data into meaningful action. jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW ALO is seeking a mid-to-senior employment attorney to manage employment counseling, contract, and policy needs as we expand in North America. This position is a great opportunity for an experienced attorney looking to take ownership of a broad array of employment issues in a fast-paced, growing company. As Senior Employment Counsel, you will serve as a key legal advisor on all aspects of employment law, policy, immigration and compliance across our U.S. and Canada operations. You will work closely with ALO’s Director of Employment, HR, Retail, and Payroll teams to ensure that our company remains compliant with local, state, federal, and international labor laws, while also addressing a wide range of legal matters related to our workforce. You will also mentor and support other members of the legal team on employment matters. The ideal candidate has six to ten years of experience with employment advice and counseling at a top employment law firm and in-house. The position is an in-office role based in Beverly Hills, CA. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide day-to-day legal advice on employment law matters, including accommodations, classification, compensation, discipline, hiring, immigration/right-to-work, leaves of absence, separations and workplace investigations.
